slices.focus: Ariana breaks down crying before work and starts short-term counseling for burnout
slices.summary: Ariana breaks down crying in her car before work, recognizing she is burned out from carrying the archive expansion plus the metadata contract. She starts short-term counseling focused on burnout, guilt, poor sleep, and the belief that rest endangers others' history.
open_loops: Building an end-of-night shutdown routine to separate work from sleep
Creating an 'actual urgent vs. emotionally urgent' two-column note
Setting clearer after-hours limits at work without full disclosure of counseling
Triage the metadata contract by committed vs. reducible pieces
decisions: Counseling is focused mainly on Ariana's burnout, guilt, poor sleep, and her belief that resting could put other people'
